spec.instructionSuffix: QUALITY PRIORITIES for the scene above: Follow the user-requested silhouette, exact count, colour landmarks and visible action before decorative detail. Part-count recommendations are not quotas: use only useful parts. Native bird + fly/flutter is preferred when wing flapping is requested; a rigid SDF bird does not flap automatically. For SDF colour landmarks, the coloured surface must protrude beyond the neighbouring skin; a buried calyx, eye or marking disappears. Use low blend radius at crisp different-colour boundaries, or separate attached geometry with a stable shared parent. Do not bury requested caps, stems, eyes or mouths inside another volume. For articulated actions, plan at least two visibly distinct poses and preserve the contact constraints in EVERY pose: both hands must keep gripping the held item while the item approaches the mouth. Animate the limb endpoints and hands together with the item using matching storyboard frames, not just the prop alone. Keep a seated pose seated throughout, with feet in front of the haunches. For compact actions use a 3..6 second readable loop with observable travel and a natural return. Before emitting JSON mentally check the starting, middle and returning poses: no gaps at joints, no detached hands or props, no penetration of the face. Do not add unsupported fields. Keep the camera fixed unless motion of the camera was requested; requested subject rotation should be applied to the whole subject including attached details.
